notes.title: Update v1.0.0
notes.content:
New models were added to streets in the beginning.
Japanese added.
Pause, Options, and Load menus changed/simplified.
Some key bindings have been changed.
Quests in the "House" mission are reduced and simplified.
The old man's face and taxi driver's face changed.
Puppet models are changed.
The interaction mechanic is renewed.
The basement mission is changed.
Saving books and read button is fixed.
The text size problem is fixed.

For any questions and problems feel free to text me. 
Contact : cladiopolis14@gmail.com
